matched_queries: UK employment guidance: Seafarers Charter standards and employer responsibilities for seafarers working on relevant maritime services.

passages.quote:
This notice should be read with:

The Merchant Shipping (Maritime Labour Convention) (Minimum Requirements for Seafarers etc.) Regulations 2014, as amended and,

Amendment 2 incorporates the requirements of the 2022 amendments to the Maritime Labour Convention, 2006 (MLC).

Notice to

shipowners

ship operators and ship managers

employers of seafarers

masters

officers and seafarers on sea-going ships ordinarily engaged in commercial operations.
